'''Trivoris''' was a lethal [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]]. One canister of Trivoris could cover a square kilometer, with one hundred percent lethality inside of ten minutes. The gas was neutralized by [[firazene]], making it completely useless.

==History==
By [[3643 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], defectors from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Havoc Squad]], led by [[Harron Tavus]], attempted to purchase canisters of Trivoris from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] within the [[Black Sun territory]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The current [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commanding officer of Havoc Squad]] successfully neutralized the gas with Firazene.
